mapper.select: SELECT s.id studentId, s.student_no, s.student_name, s.term_id, s.student_identity_id FROM t_as_guardian_student g INNER JOIN t_as_student s ON g.student_identity_id = s.student_identity_id WHERE s.school_id = #{schoolId} AND s.term_id = #{termId} AND s.is_valid = 1 AND g.is_valid = 1 AND g.bind_status = 1 AND g.guardian_user_id = #{parentId} ORDER BY s.grade_id desc,s.id desc limit 1
